notes: Gen 7 doubles, a custom game's Z-Move in a slot: Espeon flings its Micle Berry at Machop, which eats it, then uses Never-Ending Nightmare from its slot (no `-zpower`). @pkmn/client takes the Z-Move's use for a Ghostium Z, an inference the comparison marks `item_from_z_move`; the berry's boost ending (`-enditem|p1a: Machop|Micle Berry`) names another item and leaves the crystal the client holds, yet it cleared the mark, and the views were held to the client's guess. The mark goes only with a line that changes the item held or names it (DESIGN.md R-M11-17)
